package: @astryxdesign/core

# RadioListItem

Individual radio item with label, description, and content slots. Under a coarse pointer an enabled option’s target grows toward 44 px through an invisible hit area. It never shrinks below the row and stops at half the gap to a closer neighbour; the row keeps its size. That hit area is the row’s `::after`, so decorate a row with a child.

**Import:** `import {RadioListItem} from '@astryxdesign/core/RadioList';`

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `label` | `ReactNode` | - | Primary label for the radio item. Rich labels may contain links or buttons, which keep their own behavior without selecting the item. The label text names the radio; use aria-label only when that text is absent, or retain every visible label word in the override. **(required)** |
| `aria-label` | `string` | - | Plain-text accessible name for the radio, applied to the control rather than the row. It overrides the name derived from the label. Use it when a rich label has no visible text; otherwise retain every visible label word. |
| `value` | `string` | - | Value of this radio item. **(required)** |
| `description` | `ReactNode` | - | Secondary content displayed below the label. Links and buttons keep their own click behaviour — the row only delegates clicks from its non-interactive surface to the radio. |
| `align` | `'center' \| 'start' \| 'first-line'` | `'center'` | Vertical alignment of the start and end content against the label, passed through to Item unchanged. `first-line` keeps a small mark (a radio) level with the first line of a wrapped label. See Item.align. |
| `isDisabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether this individual radio item is disabled. |
| `startContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to render before the radio circle. |
| `endContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to render after the label. |
